newsitem.title: JAPAN: LDP wants to abolish stock trading tax in 98 - paper.
newsitem.headline: LDP wants to abolish stock trading tax in 98 - paper.

text.p: Japan's ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) is seeking to abolish the securities transaction tax by 1998, a senior party official in charge of tax reforms was quoted as saying.

Sohei Miyashita, a senior LDP lawmaker and an executive of the party's tax research council, said in an interview with the Mainichi Shimbun newspaper published on Wednesday that Japan must abolish the securities transaction tax and instead rely on capital gains taxes.

He was also quoted as saying that a key advisory panel to Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka needs to include specific steps to activate the stock market, such as the liberalisation of brokerage commissions, when it compiles a report in June.
